    cin >> totalLines;
    string inputString;
    cin >> inputString;
    transform(inputString.begin(), inputString.end(), inputString.begin(), ::tolower);
    string originalString = inputString;
    vector<char> characters(inputString.begin(), inputString.end());
    stack<char> st;
    for (char c : characters) {
        st.push(c);
    }
    vector<int> bracketPositions;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)characters.size(); i++) {
        if (characters[i] == '(' || characters[i] == ')') {
            st.pop();
            bracketPositions.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    map<int, int> pairsMap;
    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < bracketPositions.size(); i += 2) {
        pairsMap[bracketPositions[i]] = bracketPositions[i + 1];
    }
    vector<int> removeIndices;
    for (auto &entry : pairsMap) {
        int startIdx = entry.first;
        int endIdx = entry.second;
        for (int i = startIdx; i <= endIdx; i++) {
            removeIndices.push_back(i);
        }
    }
    vector<int> removalSet = removeIndices;
    sort(removalSet.begin(), removalSet.end());
    removalSet.erase(unique(removalSet.begin(), removalSet.end()), removalSet.end());
    vector<int> removalSetSet = removalSet; // for faster lookup
    // Create a set for faster contains check
    unordered_set<int> removalSetLookup(removalSetSet.begin(), removalSetSet.end());

    vector<char> filteredChars;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)characters.size(); i++) {
        if (removalSetLookup.find(i) == removalSetLookup.end()) {
            filteredChars.push_back(characters[i]);
        }
    }

    vector<char> replacedChars;
    bool toggleFlag = true;
    for (int i = 0; i < (int)characters.size(); i++) {
        if (removalSetLookup.find(i) != removalSetLookup.end()) {
            if (characters[i] == '(' || characters[i] == ')' || characters[i] == '_') {
                if (toggleFlag) {
                    replacedChars.push_back(' ');
                    toggleFlag = false;
                }
            } else {
                replacedChars.push_back(characters[i]);
                toggleFlag = true;
            }
        }
    }

    string finalStr(replacedChars.begin(), replacedChars.end());
    vector<string> partsAfter;
    stringstream ss(finalStr);
    string token;
    while (ss >> token) {
        partsAfter.push_back(token);
    }
    vector<int> lengthAfter;
    for (const auto &p : partsAfter) {
        string trimmed = p;
        if (!trimmed.empty()) {
            lengthAfter.push_back((int)trimmed.length());
        }
    }

    // Replace all occurrences of pattern "\\(.*?\\) ?" with space and underscores with space
    string replacedStr = inputString;
    // Remove parentheses and their content
    string tempStr;
    bool inParen = false;
    for (char c : inputString) {
        if (c == '(') {
            inParen = true;
        } else if (c == ')') {
            inParen = false;
        } else if (!inParen) {
            tempStr += c;
        }
    }
    // Replace underscores with space
    for (char &c : tempStr) {
        if (c == '_') c = ' ';
    }

    vector<string> partsBefore;
    stringstream ss2(tempStr);
    while (ss2 >> token) {
        partsBefore.push_back(token);
    }
    vector<int> lengthBefore;
    for (const auto &p : partsBefore) {
        string trimmed = p;
        if (!trimmed.empty()) {
            lengthBefore.push_back((int)trimmed.length());
        }
    }

    sort(lengthAfter.begin(), lengthAfter.end());
    int maxLength = (lengthAfter.empty()) ? 0 : lengthAfter.back();

    cout << maxLength << " " << lengthBefore.size() << "\n";

    return 0;
}
